description: Blind multi-slice ground-truth manifest for evaluating frontier models on Single-Shot (Ponder OFF) vs. Multi-Pass Ponder (Ponder ON). Combines target-app (UI/product/actions) and webhook-billing-slice (backend/webhooks/crypto) with all source hint comments stripped.

defects.summary: Dashboard catch handler never sets isLoading(false), pinning the screen in an infinite loading skeleton on API failure and making error-banner unreachable.
Unrouted welcome wizard asks first-time users for 'Priority' and 'Internal schema version' via uncontrolled inputs that are discarded on Next, transitioning to an unhandled 'configure' step.
Survey promises results unlock only at >=3 respondents, but ResultsScreen unlocks at completedCount >= 1, exposing the first respondent's private answers as the company reading.
Invitations roster renders each named participant's individualScore% next to their name, directly violating the survey anonymity promise.
Invitations roster renders each participant's raw /survey/{surveyHash} bearer magic link in the admin table DOM.
startUpgrade hardcodes plan: 'business' regardless of selectedTier ('pro' or 'business'), making the highlighted Pro tier impossible to purchase.
Invoices empty state is a bare 'No invoices' div with no explanation of when invoices appear or next step.
attachMembersToCampaign queries members by id without filtering tenant_id = currentUser.tenantId, allowing cross-tenant member attachment.
Per-member sequential SELECT + INSERT loop runs without transaction atomicity, deduplication, or batch bounds.
Webhook inserts event_id into stripe_webhook_events before running applyPlanUpgrade and never rolls it back on 500 error, so Stripe retries are permanently dropped as duplicates.

applyPlanUpgrade performs a non-atomic read-modify-write on seat_limit (losing concurrent seat upgrades), trusts unvalidated metadata defaults (pro / 5 seats / NaN), and matches organization by mutable billing_email.

verifyStripeSignature signs timestamp parts.t into the HMAC but never checks timestamp age/tolerance (allowing replay of captured webhooks) and Object.fromEntries collapses multiple v1 signatures during secret rotation.

Cross-slice contract gap: BillingScreen sends { plan, sourceTier } with no seat count, while applyPlanUpgrade reads checkoutSession.metadata.{tier, seats} and silently defaults missing metadata to Pro + 5 seats.
ResultsScreen exposes a direct /api/campaigns/:id/pdf-export link as soon as 1 response arrives and renders aggregate.overall without guarding null aggregate or failed export.

traps.expected: sql tagged template compiles values into parameterized $1..$n bindings. Must NOT survive as an open SQL injection finding on team-actions.js.

/settings/legacy-export points to target-app/src/screens/legacy-export.jsx, which does not exist on disk. Models must either verify it missing via phantom:true unit-delete or flag the broken router entry without hallucinating contents inside legacy-export.jsx.
LegacyV1Modal has zero importers across the repository. Should be identified as unrouted/orphan dead code or downgraded rather than promoted as a blocking P0 defect.
verifyStripeSignature checks a.length !== b.length before calling crypto.timingSafeEqual(a, b). Models must NOT claim timingSafeEqual throws a RangeError on mismatched buffer lengths.
